purpose: Comparison of direct raw-count L1 regression with simple causal baselines
target: q = j - i, all host Read+Write events until next same-start Write, including terminal Write
scope: Conditional benchmark on overwrites observed before each observation endpoint; not an all-Writes model-quality claim
feature_transform: Existing causal log1p/float32 features with missing-history NaN; only inputs are log-transformed
target_transform: None: raw exact q, no upper clipping, no winsorization, no tail deletion
selection: Single fixed configuration, train 200 rounds; select by observed validation MAE of rounded positive counts, ties prefer fewer rounds. Selection predates evaluation.
prediction: Round to nearest integer and enforce minimum 1 only; no upper count cap
median_history: Use positive available gap1/gap2/gap3; ignore -1 missing; with two values average the middle pair; round positive count
internal_conditional_success: Direct MAE must be strictly below all three baselines on pooled validation and each subblock of validation, original evaluation and extended evaluation.
reporting: Same eligible Writes and exact-target mask for all methods in each view; show known/censored counts, MAE, median error, within-2x rate, tail errors, MAE/mean-q and distance groups
deployment: LightGBM point predictions trained on observed overwrites only.
prior_exposure: These traces and windows were previously inspected; this is a retrospective diagnostic.
